svg.aria-label: Schematic of the research pipeline: Gaia spectra, the JANUS neural networks, labels with reliability, Starfold groups and Milky Way populations, on two supercomputers. The spectrum is a real Gaia XP spectrum of a red giant; the other stages are schematic.
